data.title: Days & Time — Starter · Lesson 1
data.subject: days
data.lyrics:
Let's go… ¡Vamos!

[Hook]
On the road… En la carretera
Windows down… Ventanas abiertas
Time to go… Hora de irse
Day by day… Día tras día
We’re on our way… Estamos en camino

[Verse]
Early in the morning… A primera hora
We hit the road with laughter.
At the hour and quarter past… Y cuarto pasadas
The sun is shining brighter.
At the last minute… A última hora
We packed our bags in a hurry.
Every other day… Cada dos días
We find a new adventure, yeah.

[Hook]
On the road… En la carretera
Windows down… Ventanas abiertas
Time to go… Hora de irse
Day by day… Día tras día
We’re on our way… Estamos en camino

[Verse]
At the end of the day… Al final del día
We watch the stars appear.
Half an hour later… Media hora más tarde
We’re still singing loud and clear.
At the same time… A la misma hora
We all feel the same beat.
In an hour… Dentro de una hora
We’ll be where our dreams meet.

[Bridge]
Good vibes… Buenas vibras
Fill the air as we ride.
With friends beside… Con amigos al lado

vocab.en: at the end of the day
at the hour and quarter past
